title: Crying Cosmic Egg
description: A large cracked spherical object resembling a dark egg or planet dominates the center, with a white stylized bird-like face on its upper half shedding multiple streams of white tears. The background contains abstract swirling patterns, golden circular motifs, and fragmented celestial or architectural forms in deep blues and warm earth tones.
